title: The Forward Pass — Special Edition — Mehr Licht! NTT R&D Forum 2026, Part One: Light Becomes the Computer
credits: Original script by The Forward Pass newsroom (guided tour of the three-part special extended edition Mehr Licht! NTT R&D Forum 2026, 20 November 2026). Primary source: the NTT R&D Forum 2026 Innovation Booklet (NTT DATA Belgium), built from NTT's official exhibit leaflets (rd.ntt/e/forum/2026); keynote context from NTT and Japanese trade-press reports of 16 November 2026. Market dates are NTT's own expectations, in Japanese fiscal years. Disclosure: the publisher of The Forward Pass is CTO of NTT DATA Belgium, part of the NTT Group; NTT did not review or sponsor this episode. The newsroom's desks run on Claude (Anthropic). The Forward Pass is an independent, personal publication.
format_note: A special edition of The Forward Pass: an original guided tour of the written edition by two AI-generated voices, scripted by the newsroom and approved by the publisher.
